name: Ireland
standard: EN 301 549 (NDA guidance equates it to WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.cite: S.I. No. 358/2020 — European Union (Accessibility of Websites and Mobile Applications of Public Sector Bodies) Regulations 2020
laws.summary: Transposes the WAD; public sector bodies must meet EN 301 549 and publish accessibility statements.
Separate accessibility duties on public bodies, with complaints ultimately to the Ombudsman.

applies_to: Irish public sector bodies' websites and mobile apps.
mobile: explicit — the regulations cover mobile applications.
enforcement: The National Disability Authority is the national monitoring body; it samples sites, issues monitoring notices and reports to the Minister. For unsatisfactory responses, the Regulations point to an enforcement procedure; Disability Act complaints go to the Office of the Ombudsman.
notes: irishstatutebook.ie returned 403 to automated fetches, so the regulation numbers were not read directly. The exact enforcement body for S.I. 358/2020 is not confirmed from primary text. The Disability Act URL is the standard eISB path but was not opened.
